description: This file defines the AppDatabase class, a Room database for managing Task entities within an Android app. It includes the singleton pattern for database instantiation and configures the database schema.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract RoomDatabase class that provides access to TaskDao and manages the singleton instance of the database.

methods.name: taskDao
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the TaskDao for database operations on Task entities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary, with fallback to destructive migration for schema changes.
